fitness_functions.name: state-space-stays-tiny-and-known
fitness_functions.description: taskq's whole model is one 4-status store over a few names; the bound must stay resolved and tiny. A jump past 1000, or a tasks domain past 256 (4 statuses x 4 names), means a new state dimension or a domain wider than the behavior -- re-read the descriptor before accepting it.

fitness_functions.name: store-stays-covered-no-new-dead-state
fitness_functions.description: Only the spec-unit case-label channel (lastInternalAction) may be invariant-unread; every variable keeps a justification linkage; and no dense rows appear beyond the two deliberate ones (tasks, the store itself, and lastCli, the observability channel).
